name: IIT Bombay
summary: IIT Bombay is a public Institute of National Importance established in 1958, with a 200-hectare campus at Powai, Mumbai. Undergraduate B.Tech admission is through JEE Advanced and JoSAA; the B.Des programme at the IDC School of Design is entered through UCEED.

totalStudents.notes: Total on-roll students per the IIT Bombay pocket statistics 2022-23 (latest edition located).

undergraduates.notes: Undergraduate/Dual Degree students per pocket statistics 2022-23.

applicationPlatform.value: JoSAA counselling after JEE Main and JEE Advanced (B.Tech); UCEED common application form for B.Des
applicationPlatform.notes: Quoted by an official-domain search result; the page itself could not be fetched directly from the sandbox.

applicationFee.notes: JEE Advanced / JoSAA / UCEED fees are set by the exam and counselling bodies; UCEED 2027 registration fee is INR 2,000 (female, SC/ST/PwD) or INR 4,000 (other Indian nationals) per a search result quoting the UCEED site; not verified on the page.

testing.notes: B.Tech entry for Indian candidates is via JEE Main then JEE Advanced and JoSAA. Foreign nationals may register for JEE Advanced directly without JEE Main (supernumerary seats capped at 10% of seats per course).

internationalTuition.notes: INR 3,00,000 per semester for foreign nationals (two semesters per year); per a search result quoting the fee circular. PIO/OCI cardholders (cards issued before 04/03/2021) admitted in OPEN pay Indian-national fees.

domesticTuition.notes: INR 1,00,000 per semester for Indian nationals (two semesters per year), excluding other fees; SC/ST/PwD are exempt from tuition fee.

scholarships.name: Institute Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: For new entrants the criterion is JEE rank (B.Tech/dual degree) or UCEED rank (B.Des); parental gross annual income must not exceed INR 4,50,000.
scholarships.coverage: Free tuition fee per semester plus INR 1,000 per month, for up to 25% of sanctioned UG intake

scholarships.name: Tuition fee exemption and free messing for SC/ST students
scholarships.eligibility: All SC/ST students (and PwD for tuition) are exempt from tuition fee; free messing for eligible SC/ST B.Tech and dual degree students.
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fee exemption; free messing where eligible

opportunities.name: SINE (Society for Innovation and Entrepreneurship)
opportunities.description: Technology business incubator at IIT Bombay supporting start-ups with incubation, mentorship and funding; alumni ventures include ideaForge and Atomberg.

opportunities.name: IIT Bombay Research Park
opportunities.description: A research park where companies set up labs and offices on campus and engage students for internships and employment.

opportunities.name: IITB Research Internship (IRCC)
opportunities.description: Full-time research internship awarded to eligible students for projects proposed by IIT Bombay faculty.

opportunities.name: International student exchange
opportunities.description: IIT Bombay has MoUs with universities abroad under which students can do coursework or project work.

opportunities.name: Campus placements and internships
opportunities.description: The 2023-24 placement and internship report records 1,475 students placed that year.

programs.name: Computer Science and Engineering (B.Tech)
programs.school: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
programs.summary: Four-year B.Tech offered by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering; admission via JEE Advanced and JoSAA.

requirements.minimum: At least 75% aggregate in five subjects in Class XII (65% for SC/ST/PwD), or within the category-wise top 20 percentile of the Class XII board
requirements.notes: Criteria are for the JEE Advanced 2026 cycle. Candidates must also qualify through JEE Main and JEE Advanced and be allotted a seat via JoSAA. Quoted by an official-domain search result; the page itself could not be fetched directly from the sandbox.

programs.name: Bachelor of Design (B.Des)
programs.summary: Four-year (eight-semester) B.Des programme at IDC School of Design, started in 2015; a five-year B.Des + M.Des dual degree is also offered.

subjects.subject: Class XII (any stream)
subjects.notes: Candidates from all streams are eligible for IIT Bombay B.Des; must have passed all five Class XII subjects in the qualifying year(s) stated by UCEED (2025/2026 for the 2026 cycle; Class XII passed in 2026 or appearing in 2027 for UCEED 2027).
